content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes cellulose and polymer ingredients for personal care and pharma, not industrial process fluids or metalworking chemicals."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Designs and builds asphalt plants and crushing machinery, a equipment business rather than chemical fluids."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Distributes MRO products and repairs pumps as a distributor, not formulating chemical process fluids or lubricants."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Makes specialty polymers, fibers and intermediates for many industries, not metalworking or process fluid chemicals."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Sells refining catalysts and acid regeneration services, a different chemistry and service model from Quaker's fluids."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Distributes plumbing, HVAC and waterworks products to contractors through branches, a distributor model."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures pumps, valves, brake friction parts and connectors, which are equipment and components, not chemical fluids."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Sells paints and coatings, mainly automotive and architectural, rather than metalworking fluids, rust preventives and process oils."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Focuses on roofing, sealants, consumer paints and installation services, a construction and consumer business."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Makes locks, hinges and metal hardware and castings, a hardware component business with no chemical products."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Makes bearings and power transmission components, mechanical parts rather than lubricants or chemical fluids."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Sells coding printers, inks and water instruments, a product identification and instrumentation business."}]}
